items.text: grain and film are soft film grain now, as in Photoshop: small soft clumps, strongest in the midtones, not dithering
a 16:9 card for video screens (1920×1080), on the same grid
stills are sharp: drawn again at their own size, as far as the device can hold (up to four times the screen), instead of the screen being stretched
card texture: none, grain (the default), film or stipple, over the look and under the type and marks
cards are sharp: the particles are drawn again at the card's own size (up to four times the screen's) instead of the screen's pixels being stretched
the card previews have arrows either side and dots under them, so it is clear they move (and the arrows and dots pick a card)
saved files are named and numbered: CHAMY·XYZ_Current_App_000001.jpg, one running number for cards, stills and videos; cards save as .jpg
cards with the look behind carry a small duck-rabbit in the bottom right corner, on the margins, as wide (without the rabbit's tail) as the namemark's two turned words
CURRENT on the cards is not letterspaced

cards on the CHAMY·XYZ brand grid: a margin of a twelfth of the short side on every edge; the namemark's x-height on the top and right margins; CURRENT down the left column, its capitals one margin tall; CHAMY·XYZ on the left and bottom margins, its capitals the namemark's x-height; the sentence's last line on the bottom margin; the duck-rabbit in the room left. The same composition at every size
